scope: Durable cash batches, queued void obligations and completed custody refunds. No production worker or sender is installed.

checks.intent_before_each_financial_signer: Persisted before Authorize, with a payer-session/active-intent guard on each callback. Source authority remains required by Reader.
checks.payer_nonce_and_unsigned_payload: Persisted before controlled transaction signing; all EIP-1559 fields and recovered sender checked before raw persistence.
checks.raw_before_broadcast: Actual broadcaster callback reads and compares the committed PostgreSQL raw bytes.
checks.crash_discovery: Active lookup finds the planned intent after closing/reopening the owner session.
checks.mined_revert: Actual insufficient-gas transaction reverted; no financial proof was accepted; next intent used the next consumed nonce.
checks.uncertain_send: Actual pending broadcast with injected lost response; restart retained exact hash/raw/nonce without new financial signatures.
checks.nonce_conflict: Injected nonce-read conflict halted observation; no nonce or ticket claim was released.
checks.rpc_failure: Injected receipt outage remained an error; JSON null alone means receipt absence.
checks.atomic_completion: A PostgreSQL trigger rejected terminal persistence after proof/ticket inserts. Both proof and paid-ticket rows rolled back; included work remained discoverable and retried successfully.
checks.payer_and_ticket_concurrency: A second owner could not acquire the payer session. Another payer could not claim overlapping tickets.
checks.retirement: Unexpired and raw-prepared intents could not be abandoned; an expired never-prepared intent released the lane while retaining its audit row.
checks.already_settled_retry: Reconciled proof remained identical; no new broadcast callback.
checks.void_receipts: Separate queue and completion proofs verify actual transaction input, canonical events, original owner/stake, zero LP PnL and no pool/custody USDC movement. See daily-void-review.json.
checks.replacement_and_cancellation: All signed hashes remain tracked at one nonce. Explicit fee replacement preserves the financial call; confirmed intrinsic-gas cancellation releases only processing claims. The actual winner determines receipt proof. See daily-replacement-review.json.
checks.external_recovery: Signed raw/body, recovered sender, block membership/index and semantic proof are separate from nonce cleanup. Exact externally submitted adapter calls and reserved nonce consumers pass locally. See daily-external-review.json.

observed_review_corrections.issue: Missing receipt versus RPC failure must remain distinguishable.
observed_review_corrections.resolution: ReadRPC permits null only for transaction-receipt lookup; tests retain errors for other null reads.

observed_review_corrections.issue: The outbound owner session could die between financial signer callbacks.
observed_review_corrections.resolution: Each injected role call checks the same non-reconnecting outbound session and active intent.

assumptions: PostgreSQL durability and honest authenticated RPC access are infrastructure requirements.
The payer is dedicated to the lane.
The injected transaction signer never broadcasts.
Confirmation depth and immutable receipt anchors are candidate policy, not validated public-chain finality.
Gas/fee inputs are explicit synthetic test settings, not approved production limits.
remaining: approved production fee and recovery policy
